description_for_human: Complete year-round property care in Rutland County, Vermont — grounds maintenance, landscaping, snow & ice management, hardscaping, carpentry, housekeeping, and rental property support.
description_for_model: Meticulous LLC is a licensed Vermont property-care and management company serving Rutland County and the Killington area since 2009. Services include grounds maintenance and lawn care, landscaping and exterior enhancements, snow and ice management, hardscaping, carpentry and construction, housekeeping and turnover, and rental property support for primary residences, second homes, and short-term rentals.
